objective: Complete only the missing M1 content-contract slice on top of the approved M0 interfaces and frozen M1 design artifacts. Upgrade the existing StageTimeline, PatternDefinition, BossPhaseDefinition, and DifficultyProfile contracts without breaking their M0 constructors or callers, and add one bounded M1 content catalog that loads content/design/m1_stage_beats.json and content/design/m1_phase_cards.json as runtime data. The catalog must expose all six stages in authored order, all 108 beats grouped into exactly three segments per stage, and all 40 boss/midboss phases in authored encounter order with the exact 26 spell / 14 nonspell split. Every phase contract must expose its unique ID, owner and encounter slot, deterministic random stream ID, emitter schedules, ordered four-event timeline, bullet motion rules, three-part Boss movement trace, failure/capture conditions, warning contract, Normal structure, Hard topology transformation, and canonical structure fingerprint. Hard must be represented as an authored topology/graph or route transformation for every phase and must not be satisfiable by changing only speed or count. Add a stable, side-effect-free derivation from run seed plus deterministic stream ID to a phase-local seed so replay consumers can obtain the same stream without consuming or mutating the shared gameplay RNG. Recompute each stored fingerprint from the frozen canonical input order and reject duplicates or drift. Extend StageDirector only with additive query methods needed by later M2-M5 content implementation; do not switch the current six playable stages to the new choreography, do not implement individual projectile patterns, and do not modify current legacy aliases or wave data. Add one focused behavioral GDScript assertion that exercises the real catalog and public definitions: exact identities/order/counts, warning minima, non-transition gap limit, six fought midbosses and six boss-front climaxes, Normal/Hard topology distinction on all 40 phases, canonical fingerprint recomputation/uniqueness, deterministic stream seed stability/separation, and compatibility of the original M0 constructors. Do not launch Godot in this implementation run; executable validation is gated by an independent reviewer and the guarded runner.
acceptance_commands: $changed=@(git diff --name-only f787f8fdee06a72024db0712a17e9f96ca814b57..HEAD); if($changed | Where-Object { $_ -notin @('scripts/content/stage_timeline.gd','scripts/content/pattern_definition.gd','scripts/content/boss_phase_definition.gd','scripts/content/difficulty_profile.gd','scripts/content/m1_content_catalog.gd','scripts/runtime/stage_director.gd','tests/assert_m1_content_contracts.gd') }){ throw "Out-of-scope path: $($changed -join ',')" }; Write-Host 'M1_CONTENT_SCOPE=pass'

$stage=Get-Content content/design/m1_stage_beats.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $phase=Get-Content content/design/m1_phase_cards.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if($stage.stages.Count-ne 6 -or @($stage.stages.beats).Count-ne 108 -or $phase.phases.Count-ne 40){throw 'Frozen M1 source counts drifted'}; Write-Host 'M1_FROZEN_SOURCE_COUNTS=pass'
if(@(Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object ProcessName -Like 'Godot*').Count-ne 0){throw 'Godot process exists during implementation'}; Write-Host 'GODOT_PROCESS_COUNT=0'
output_requirements: Report the additive public API and how M0 constructor/caller compatibility is preserved
Report the exact 6-stage, 108-beat, 40-phase, 26/14 identity evidence and mapping to legacy encounter order
Report how each phase exposes warning, movement, failure/capture, Normal structure, and a non-numeric Hard topology transformation
Report the exact canonical fingerprint algorithm and evidence that all 40 recompute uniquely
Report the phase-local seed derivation and why it does not consume or mutate shared gameplay RNG
Report every changed file, acceptance command and exit code, tests intentionally not run, Godot launch count zero, and residual risks reserved for M2-M5 implementation

Confirm current stage waves, legacy pattern aliases, current gameplay, frozen JSON/docs, audio imports, tools, replay format, UI, save data, project settings, tickets, and readiness ledger were not changed
context: M0 already provides minimal version-1 StageTimeline, PatternDefinition, BossPhaseDefinition, and DifficultyProfile classes. Extend them additively; do not replace them or force current callers to migrate in this ticket.

The frozen machine sources are content/design/m1_stage_beats.json and content/design/m1_phase_cards.json, with interpretation in docs/content/m1-design-freeze.md. They are read-only inputs and must not be edited.

M1 freezes contracts and tooling, not final playable implementation of all 40 phases. M2 builds the Stage 2 golden slice and M3-M5 implement the remaining content. Do not claim design data is already playable.

The canonical fingerprint field order is grammar, role-qualified emitter composition, ordered timeline events, Boss movement graph, Normal topology, Hard transformation, warning contract. Cosmetic names, owner names, HP, timeout, bullet speed, and bullet count are excluded.
Authored warning minima are Normal 18 and Hard 12 across the frozen cards, exceeding the product floor of Normal 12 and Hard 8. Every non-transition stage beat has max_gap_after_frames at most 180.

Do not start Godot or any import-producing tool. The release lead will obtain an independent static gate before exactly one guarded focused executable assertion. Do not commit, merge, spawn subagents, or rewrite the project plan.
